profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Uber
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I am a passionate and experienced backend developer with a diverse background in multiple technologies, with expertise in distributed systems, big data platforms, and building reliable and robust systems. Known for a track record of innovative solutions and leading projects successfully, I enjoy tackling new challenges and business-critical problems. In addition, I strive to induce a collaborative environment that helps to drive efficient results that meet business and customers' needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of 10+ engineers to deliver an order recovery feature to simplify an eater’s experience when their order is unfulfilled or canceled, resulting in over 300K orders saved per year, with a $5M incremental gross bookings (GB). In addition, the feature has a usage run rate of over $10M GB each year.
• Built a cross-organization alerting platform and framework that involved data ingestion pipelines, real-time data processing, and monitoring systems, which has detected over 300+ outages related to UberEat’s 3rd party integrations, saving over $50M gross bookings (GB) per year.   
• Developed a real-time dashboard visualization and framework used by 60+ unique users, saving 27+ business days per month. The framework was further extended and used by 3+ other cross-functional teams. 
• Led and implemented an initiative across the UberEats Delivery organization to make every service zone agnostic or portable, capable of serving traffic in any zone in a given region. This effort spanned across 190+ services and 28 teams, and provided higher reliability and increased fault-tolerance to all services, allowing for zonal failover.
• Drove operational excellence programs within the organization, interfacing with multiple teams to improve endpoint latency and availability, observability, endpoint graceful degradation, and conduct incident reviews.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Surfaced inefficiencies in a capacity ordering system by constructing a daily reporting mechanism and made improvements to the hardware delivery calendar, cutting hardware delivery time by 66%
• Redesigned an internal Ruby on Rails web page by modularizing the code into maintainable classes and improving the efficiency of the queries on the page, reducing the page load time by 90%
• Built a metrics aggregation platform utilizing Spark, EMR, and serverless architecture to process server utilization metrics across the company, optimizing original application runtime from 23 hours to under 10 minutes, and surfacing millions in savings potential
• Implemented an automated workflow using Amazon Simple Workflow Service to handle the lifecycle of compute capacity in the cloud for internal AWS teams, removing the need for manual intervention to replace hosts and saving thousands of hours of developers’ time across the company

Technologies:  Large-scale distributed databases (Amazon Aurora, DynamoDb, Redshift), Apache Spark, Serverless Architecture, Elasticsearch, Data Pipelines, and more

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Held office hours to mentor and provide assistance to students enrolled in the course, Computer Systems and Programming (CS367), an introduction to machine-level representation and computer systems. In addition, I monitored the online class forum to answer any course or programming-related questions

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked on patching and improving the code base for a modeling and simulation system for the US Marines, gaining exposure to software configuration management systems 
• Implemented a simulation of a message sequence between two marine subsystems and updated the software’s GUI interfaces for defective physics and graphical issues  
• Performed extensive unit and systems integration testing and participated in software code reviews
• Recognized for innovative solutions and as a top performing intern

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description:
• Tutored high school students in college-level subjects including calculus, introductory chemistry, and physics
• Prepared students for the SAT math, reading, and writing sections

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: • Promoted awareness of the start-up company by modernizing the company website using HTML/CSS/Javascript and proposing marketing ideas to generate media presence and revenue

honors.description: Awarded for high marks in the Engineering school
